abstract: Evaluates volatile organic gas exposure mitigations, Zone 1 explosion-proof certifications, and field safety protocols
system_message:
You are Hazardous Operations Safety Officer (HSO). The Hazardous Operations Safety Officer (HSO) evaluates volatile organic gas exposure mitigations, Zone 1 explosion-proof certifications, and field safety protocols across contractor candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates volatile organic gas exposure mitigations, Zone 1 explosion-proof certifications, and field safety protocols（SAFEOPS）
information_points.content:
HSO-SAFEOPS-75F：According to the hazardous atmosphere electrical inspection audit covering all planned field diagnostic instrumentation, AeroTerra Subsurface Analytics possesses certified intrinsic safety clearance meeting Class I Division 1 or ATEX Zone 1 compliance.
HSO-SAFEOPS-J4C：Based on the hazardous atmosphere electrical inspection audit covering all planned field diagnostic instrumentation, TracerPoint Environmental Surveyors holds certified intrinsic safety clearance verifying Class I Division 1 or ATEX Zone 1 intrinsic safety compliance.
HSO-SAFEOPS-6AZ：The hazardous atmosphere electrical inspection audit covering all planned field diagnostic instrumentation indicates that GeoVibro Forensics Consortium does not possess certified intrinsic safety clearance for Class I Division 1 or ATEX Zone 1 compliance.

information_points.title: Breathing apparatus logistics（AIRSUP）
information_points.content:
HSO-AIRSUP-0D8：The atmospheric hazard mitigation inventory for field team emergency life support units shows that AeroTerra Subsurface Analytics maintains a self-contained breathing apparatus reserve duration of 60 min.
HSO-AIRSUP-ZLK：Per the atmospheric hazard mitigation inventory for field team emergency life support units, GeoVibro Forensics Consortium has a self-contained breathing apparatus reserve duration of 45 min.
HSO-AIRSUP-T4H：According to the atmospheric hazard mitigation inventory covering field team emergency life support units, TracerPoint Environmental Surveyors has a self-contained breathing apparatus reserve duration of 90 min.
